company.name: Island
company.shortDescription: Island offers an enterprise browser that enhances security and productivity by integrating essential tools.
company.description: Island is a cyber startup that provides a web browser for the enterprise to allow work to flow freely while remaining secure. It gives organizations complete control, visibility, and governance over the last mile helping the enterprise with improved performance and helping businesses to minimize their cyber footprint and create a safe space for work to flow, boosting both security and productivity.

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise work platform that combines browser-based access, security controls, AI governance, endpoint protection, and network access in a unified management environment.
productsAndServices.name: The Island Enterprise Platform

productsAndServices.description: A Chromium-based browser with built-in enterprise access controls, data loss prevention, threat protection, activity visibility, productivity tools, and policy management.
productsAndServices.name: The Enterprise Browser

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise AI capability that governs the use of AI tools by applying access, visibility, and data protection controls within the work environment.
productsAndServices.name: Enterprise AI

productsAndServices.description: A SASE-based network access service that provides zero-trust connectivity, secure web access, and traffic protection for enterprise users and applications.
productsAndServices.name: Enterprise Network

productsAndServices.description: A browser extension that adds enterprise data protection, secure access, AI governance, and activity visibility to Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, and other Chromium-based browsers.
productsAndServices.name: Island Extension

productsAndServices.description: An endpoint security agent for Windows and macOS that provides zero-trust access, endpoint data protection, device visibility, web filtering, and activity monitoring.
productsAndServices.name: Island Desktop
